description_en: Queries the logon information of a specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 查询指定RAM用户的登录信息
name: GetLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

AutoDisableLoginStatus.description_en: Specifies whether console logon is automatically disabled when the idle disablement conditions are met. This feature is enabled by default and cannot be disabled
AutoDisableLoginStatus.description_zh: 在满足闲置禁用条件后是否自动禁用控制台登录。默认开启，不可关闭

LastLoginTime.description_en: The last console logon time in UTC
LastLoginTime.description_zh: 上次登录控制台时间（UTC时间）

MFABindRequired.description_en:
Specifies whether the user is required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA). Valid values:

false: MFA is not required.
true: MFA is required
MFABindRequired.description_zh:
是否强制要求用户开启多因素认证。取值：

false：不要求开启多因素认证。
true：必须开启多因素认证

PasswordResetRequired.description_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user must reset the password upon the next logon. Valid values:

false: The user is not required to reset the password.
true: The user must reset the password
PasswordResetRequired.description_zh:
RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码。取值：

false：不要求重置密码。
true：必须重置密码

PasswordStatus.description_en:
The status of the initial password. An initial password is the password set when console logon is newly created or re-enabled. Valid values:

"NotInitial": The password is not an initial password.
"InitialValid": The initial password is valid.
"InitialExpired": The initial password has expired
PasswordStatus.description_zh:
初始密码的状态。初始密码指新创建或重新启用控制台登录设置的密码。

取值
"NotInitial"：非初始密码。
"InitialValid"：初始密码有效。
"InitialExpired"：初始密码已过期

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether console logon is enabled or disabled. Valid values:

Active: Console logon is enabled.
Inactive: Console logon is disabled
Status.description_zh:
开启或禁用控制台登录。取值：

Active：开启控制台登录。
Inactive：禁用控制台登录

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
